title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
summary: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.
reason: OpenAI's statement about ending live-internet training is a company self-policy/data-practice change, not a model release, research artifact, business event (financing, M&A, partnership, market data, non-model product launch), government policy action, or OSS tool release. No active rule covers it.
